summary: Sanders County lookout near Hot Springs: a 30-foot pole L-4 tower listed for 1934 and gone in 1965. A Thompson peak near Superior, quoted on the montanalookouts page, may be a different site.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone in 1965; no source describes the summit now

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The montanalookouts page files a Thompson Peak under Sanders County but also quotes a June 19, 1947 item (The Mineral Independent) about a Thompson peak near Superior. The state list shows a separate Thompson Peak in Mineral County. No page read links Superior to Mineral County, so the story does not assert that link. The story uses only the Sanders County firelookout entry and the state list line for it, and mentions the Superior item only as a reason for caution, not as a source of dates.

notes_for_editor: Keep separate from us-mt-thompson-peak-2, which is the Mineral County peak near Superior (standing, rebuilt 1934 and 1984). Its firelookout.com/mt/thompsonpk.html page is a different structure, so do not merge the two. The Sanders summit has one lookout-specific source, a single firelookout.com line. The montanalookouts page is ambiguous and is used only as a caution. Access is left unset. Story is about 174 words.
